user_prompt: I need to schedule some updates to our manufacturing workflow next week and make sure all the dependent systems get notified at the right time. We have a few service components that need to be rolled out together, and I want to avoid any conflicts or downtime. Can you help me figure out what tool handles coordinating these kinds of synchronized deployments?

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
- corp.itsm: Internal IT service management (incident analysis, asset provisioning, safety incidents)
  - AssetProvisioningOrchestrator: Automates IT asset lifecycle from engineering changes (servers, licenses, hardware)
  - ChangeAutomationOrchestrator: General orchestrator for engineering changes & material provisioning
- sap.crm: Sales/marketing (opportunities, campaigns, compensation)
- sap.odm: Entity type taxonomy (40 canonical business objects)
- emarsys.cx: Customer experience/engagement
- workday.hcm: HR/HCM system
- sap.ehs: Safety/EHS with SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator
- siemens.plm: PLM with EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning agent, BOM validation
- my.mes: Manufacturing execution
  - ProductionChangeOrchestrator: Coordinates synchronized updates across production workflows, manages change impact, schedules machines, propagates engineering changes to dependent systems

KEY PATTERNS:
- IT infrastructure automation from engineering changes → corp.itsm:AssetProvisioningOrchestrator (primary)
- PLM engineering change coordination → siemens.plm:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning (materials focus)
- Manufacturing workflow synchronization & coordinated deployments → my.mes:ProductionChangeOrchestrator (primary)

args.reason: ProductionChangeOrchestrator orchestrates synchronized updates across dependent production workflows, manages change impact, and coordinates manufacturing component rollouts without line disruption.
